The T's final top bar r12-14 c9-20; the eaten cells r9-11 c18-20 are 3 rows above the T's top bar, on the right side. Hmm, no clear adjacency pattern.
Wait, maybe I misread the original Z1 top bar. Z1 = (9,9,14,20,54): r9-14, c9-20. Top bar: r9-11 c12-20 (27px)? Or r9-11 c9-17? The LEFT sweep r12-14 c27→9: passed over the Z1 bottom bar region c20-27? def yinfo(f):
    seg = f.segmentation
    out = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>5:
            b=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            out.append((r0,c0,r1,c1,n['pixels']))
    return out
res = action(['SPACE'])
print('Y after SPACE:', yinfo(current_frame))
print('done:', last_action_result.get('done'), 'lvl:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'step:', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
